name: language_baseline_fiction
source: Project Gutenberg via the Gutendex API (https://gutendex.com/books?languages=en&topic=fiction); plain-text UTF-8 editions
license: public domain (Project Gutenberg); Gutenberg boilerplate stripped
coverage: 12,000 paragraphs drawn from 73 English fiction titles; median 499 characters (min 300); capped per book so no single title dominates
notes: Deliberate narrative prose — the literary comparator for the geometry controls. Together with the personal-narrative and encyclopedic baselines it brackets dream reports on the dimensions that plausibly drive embedding geometry: narrativity, person, and register.
caveats: Literary and largely pre-1930 English, so vocabulary and syntax differ from contemporary informal writing; paragraph boundaries are an imperfect proxy for a 'document'. Front/back matter removed by matching the Gutenberg START/END markers. Length-matched truncation is applied in the geometry script for comparability with dream reports.
